mechanism: CPositionSizer dispatches fixed-fractional, fixed-monetary, ATR-stop, and equity-curve drawdown scaling into a shared OrderCalcProfit lot converter; demo EA only logs sizing results.
data_needed: Account balance/equity; symbol volume constraints; optional ATR handle; stop distance in points.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 symbol (forex/indices/CFDs); ATR example on PERIOD_H1 period 14.
why_new_for_mis: No market-state sensing—risk-policy and lot conversion only.
quote: This article builds CPositionSizer, an engine that separates two questions: how much should I risk, and how do I turn that risk into a lot size.

mechanism: CTradeThrottle token-bucket rate limiter with priority queue; Submit/OnTimer pacing for OrderSend; optional dynamic Configure on volatility mentioned only as extension.
data_needed: Caller order params; bucket capacity/refill rate; queue capacity; millisecond timer.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart symbol; demo burst on attached symbol.
why_new_for_mis: Execution infrastructure and broker pacing, not market regime/vol/liquidity sensing.
quote: This is an infrastructure throttle layer focused specifically on pacing and queuing. It is not a complete, production-ready execution engine.

mechanism: Sliding W closes → SMA equilibrium; re-express window as normalised returns about SMA; map current/min/max to empirical CDF fractiles f_w,f_min,f_max on [0,1] comparable across assets.
data_needed: Trailing W closes; Fractile ECDF count; buffers for f_w/f_min/f_max and RMA family.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 visuals; Strategy Tester EURUSD H2 ~14 months.
why_new_for_mis: Self-normalising local-rank sensor of where price sits inside its own recent distribution—portable across symbols without fixed pip thresholds.
quote: We also map its curves [...] to corresponding fractile values [...] This transforms the RMA indicator into a representation on a [0, 1] scale, making it directly comparable across different assets.

mechanism: Range of normalised returns R_k compared to historical min/max via Relative Extremum Ratios R/m and R/M plus least-squares slope and z-score → expansion, contraction, to-expansion, to-contraction, or hold previous; Adaptive Crossover Exit switches Full Distribution Crossover in contraction vs Extremum Revert Trigger in expansion/transition.
data_needed: Per-bar normalised return range; historical range floor/ceiling lookback; slope and z of range; regime lookback params.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 regime backdrop; EURUSD H2 tester.
why_new_for_mis: Geometric expansion/contraction of the local return envelope as an explicit regime state that gates exit logic—MIS can sense distribution widening vs coiling without ATR alone.
quote: Trades are typically initiated at the onset of an expansion phase and closed during contraction.

mechanism: d_med_w = f_w−0.5; D_k = share of last lookback bar-to-bar increases in d_med_w; safety exit when long below median with low D_k (or short above median with high D_k)—offside plus continuing adverse steps.
data_needed: f_w series; AdverseMonitor lookback; adverse_down/up thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 adverse panel; EURUSD H2 EA.
why_new_for_mis: Separates temporary mean-reversion drawdown from genuine adverse walk of the fractile—precise change/failure sensor for open risk.
quote: The real warning sign is being offside and watching the fractile keep stepping further offside, which is exactly what a low D_k on the wrong side of the median describes.

mechanism: Log-returns window → SAX z-normalize + Gaussian-quantile alphabet → LZ76 Kaspar–Schuster phrase count c(n); normalize C=c(n)·ln(n)/(n·ln a) near 1 for noise and lower for structure; indicator plots trailing efficiency.
data_needed: Close window (default 200); alphabet (default 5); optional PAA; returns vs levels mode.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD and gold; H1 and M5 market scan (2000×200-bar windows on M5).
why_new_for_mis: Parameter-light compressibility sensor of serial regularity vs noise—MIS efficiency/regime readout distinct from autocorrelation knobs.
quote: A value near 1.0 means the recent moves look like independent coin flips, an efficient tape with no memory. A value clearly below 1.0 means the moves carry serial structure

mechanism: Decompose walk−real gap: Gaussian walk vs shuffled real returns (distribution) vs real (serial); permutation test on shuffle means; alphabet-2 (sign-only) pass isolates directional structure from volatility clustering that lowers complexity.
data_needed: Real log-returns; Fisher–Yates shuffles; Sweep of efficiency; alphabet 5 magnitude vs alphabet 2 direction.
why_new_for_mis: Honest diagnostic stack so MIS attributes low complexity to fat tails vs vol clustering vs direction—avoids mistaking distribution for edge.
quote: Structure that survives the alphabet-2 pass is directional; structure that vanishes in it was volatility, not direction.

mechanism: NCD(x,y)=(C(xy)−min(C(x),C(y)))/max(C(x),C(y)) with LZ76 phrase count as C on SAX strings; nearest-analog search over historical windows; forward-return control shows retrieval ≠ prediction.
data_needed: Two SAX symbol strings; concatenation complexity; rolling candidate windows (e.g. 200 bars, 5601 candidates on EURUSD).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD 200-bar query vs history; forward 20-bar log-return null.
why_new_for_mis: Literal shared-substructure distance for path-shape matching after scale removal—MIS template/similarity sensor without claiming forecast.
quote: NCD detects literal shared substructure, which makes it a good tool for asking whether one price window looks like another

mechanism: Vol-scale deltas (22d EWMA); six-speed EMA oscillators; pairwise Derivative DTW on standardised derivatives → skew-symmetric lag matrix V; convex graph learner (projected gradient) → sparse A; ensemble windows [22..132]; propagate neighbour oscillators via A_norm; reverting-sigmoid average → per-symbol network momentum sign.
data_needed: Date-aligned D1 closes for FX tradeables + cross-asset detectors; lookback≥133; graph rebuild interval.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: ~40-symbol network; chart EURUSD/EURNZD; signal on D1, tester M30 execution clock July 2026.
why_new_for_mis: Cross-market lead-lag network as a spillover sensor—MIS reads who leads whom and propagated momentum, not single-chart MACD.
quote: A leader's momentum should count toward the signal of the laggers it leads, weighted by how strong the connection is. That is what "network momentum" means

mechanism: Causal feature matrix (ret/σ trailing, range/ATR, body/range, gap, drift_z, short/long volratio; optional path mode); ensemble of random isolation trees on psi subsample; score s=2^(-E[h]/c(ψ)); calibrated percentile threshold; OOS indicator and strategy gate.
data_needed: OHLC history; volWin trailing sigma ending i−1; nTrees/psi/seed; train/display split.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1/H1; BTCUSD D1; EURUSD H1 indicator check; gate demo XAUUSD H1 2022–2026.
why_new_for_mis: Multivariate unsupervised unusual-bar sensor distinct from univariate |z|; MIS can gate entries on calibrated anomaly without modeling normal density.
quote: Anomalies are few and different, so instead of describing the crowd, cut the space at random and count how many cuts it takes to leave a point on its own.

mechanism: OLAPQuotes cube: DayHour × WorkWeekDay selectors; ProfitFactorAggregator on OC range (and custom1 = signed(|OC|−spread)); cells with PF≫1 or ≪1 mark hour×weekday directional bias for schedule-based entries.
data_needed: MqlRates bars; datetime filter range; hour-of-day and weekday selectors; OC or spread-adjusted custom field.
why_new_for_mis: Session/calendar structure sensor from multi-dimensional quote aggregation—MIS can flag hour×weekday regimes with asymmetric drift after spread.
quote: If prevailing price movements are not symmetric at some hours or on some days of the week, we can use this to open deals.

mechanism: Average/Max/VarianceAggregator of FIELD_SPREAD sliced by DayHourSelector on M1 (and H1); maps intraday liquidity cost and spread volatility for filters.
data_needed: Bar spread field from MqlRates; hour-of-day selector; AVG/MAX/DEVIATION aggregators.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit hour-of-day liquidity/spread sensor with variance—MIS can avoid thin hours or scale for spread shocks.
quote: These values represent the single standard deviation, based on which it is possible to configure filters in scalping strategies or robots that are based on volatility impulses.

mechanism: PivotLeft/Right swing pivots; bullish/bearish Crab XABCD with B≈0.618 XA, BC∈[0.382,0.886] AB, CD≈1.618 XA beyond X; confirm next bar; visualize PRZ and trade at D.
data_needed: OHLC pivots; Fibonacci tolerance; five latest alternating pivots.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart symbol/_Period; backtest section in article.
why_new_for_mis: Geometric deep-extension PRZ completion sensor—MIS can flag extreme harmonic structure events as discrete path-state.
quote: The final leg should extend 1.618 of the XA leg, marking the potential reversal zone at point D, where the pattern completes and a trade signal is generated.

mechanism: Same pivot engine as Crab; Bat ratios B≈0.5 XA, BC∈[0.382,0.886] AB, D at 0.886 XA (shallower than Crab 1.618); bullish D above X / bearish D below X.
data_needed: Swing pivots; Tolerance on Fib legs; locked X confirmation.
why_new_for_mis: Companion harmonic structure sensor with 0.886 XA completion—MIS can distinguish shallow vs deep harmonic PRZs.
quote: The final leg should extend 0.886 of the XA leg, marking the potential reversal zone at point D

mechanism: MathMoments over InpPeriod closes → mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis; JB=n(skew²/6+kurt²/24); z from NormalInverse for CI; buy if price<lower_CI and skew<adaptive(−0.3−0.05·kurt) and JB>threshold (mirror sell); kurtosis cap; optional HTF mean/skew alignment.
data_needed: CopyClose period; confidence level; JB/kurtosis thresholds; optional higher TF closes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Attached chart symbol/TF; optional InpHigherTF confirmation.
why_new_for_mis: Distribution-shape gated confidence-interval breach sensor—MIS reads non-normality and skew-adapted extremes, not plain z alone.
quote: generates reversion signals based on confidence intervals with adaptive thresholds and higher timeframe confirmation

mechanism: Least-squares slope/intercept/stdDev over RegressionPeriod; create channel only if |slope|≥MinSlopeThreshold; extend while price contained else recreate if deviation > UpdateThresholdPercent of width; breakout entries; middle-line cross exits; Normal/Inverse modes.
data_needed: Close array of RegressionPeriod; Deviations multiplier; min slope; update %; extension %.
why_new_for_mis: Trend-gated regression envelope that rebuilds on structural break—MIS channel-containment and recreate events as regime-change cues.
quote: It only activates when the absolute slope exceeds a minimum threshold to ensure a trending market. Additionally, it automatically recreates the channel when the price deviates beyond a configurable percentage of the channel width

mechanism: ext_bars swing high/low vs neighbours; label HH/LH/LL/HL vs prior swing to set trend; bullish CHoCH = close above recent swing high in downtrend; bearish CHoCH = close below recent swing low in uptrend; PerBar/PerTick modes.

quote: CHoCH occurs when price breaks the most recent swing high during a downtrend (bullish reversal) or the recent swing low during an uptrend (bearish reversal)
